description:
Because:

- connected-services lived in packages/fxa-shared, which moves to Nx libs.
- fxa-auth-server must load one copy of the code, with no shim.

This commit:

- Adds libs/accounts/connected-services with the moved files and jest specs.
- Points the fxa-auth-server, fxa-admin-server and amplitude.ts imports at it.
- Adds the tsconfig paths and the root cldr-localenames-full dependency.
- Deletes packages/fxa-shared/connected-services, its tests and exports.

Closes FXA-10653
